description: UDL International Limited is the entity that survived the April 2024 merger of First UDL Modaraba into it, and is the listed arm of a UDL group that began in 1887 as distributor of W.D. & H.O. Wills cigarettes. Its stated principal line of business is to provide services and trade in products permissible under law, and it is focused on Islamic financial services through its subsidiary UDL Financial Services Limited. The company says it plans to expand into FMCG, skin care and food brands.
